# @almadar/runtime — agent guide

Interpreted runtime for Almadar orbital applications (OrbitalServerRuntime)

This repo is one submodule of the Almadar monorepo (natural language → `.orb` program → full-stack app). It works on its own: every sibling package is installed from npm / GitHub Packages at its pinned version, never read from a neighbouring folder. When you run inside the monorepo checkout, the root `CLAUDE.md` also applies, and it wins wherever the two differ.

## This repo
- **Path in the monorepo:** `packages/almadar-runtime`
- **Kind:** TypeScript package — the JS runtime interpreter (runtime execution path)
- **Published:** publicly, to npm as `@almadar/runtime`
- **Upstream (this repo imports them):** `@almadar/core`, `@almadar/evaluator`, `@almadar/integrations`, `@almadar/logger`, `@almadar/server`, `@almadar/std`
- **Downstream (they import this repo):** `@almadar/ui`, `@almadar/server`, `@almadar-io/parity`, `@almadar/mobile`, `@almadar-io/verify`, `@almadar-io/ljuba`, `@almadar-io/runtime-verify-tool`, `@almadar-io/playground-runtime`, `@almadar-io/agent-trace`, `@almadar/sdk`, `@almadar-io/rabit`, `kflow-nata`, `@almadar-io/tools`
- **Reference doc (monorepo only):** `docs/Almadar_Runtime.md`

## Check — "done" means this is green
```bash
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm typecheck
pnpm build
pnpm test
pnpm exec eslint --no-warn-ignored --max-warnings 0 <files you touched>
```
Lint every file you touched with `--max-warnings 0`. CI (`.github/workflows/`: `ci.yml`, `publish.yml`) runs the same steps on push and pull request; a change is not finished until it passes there too.

## Rules
- **Stay in this repo.** Never edit, vendor or copy sibling source. If the right fix is upstream (see Upstream above), stop and write it up in your report or PR body: the file, the fix, and why. Don't patch around it here.
- **Main line only.** Commit to `main`. If your harness requires a branch (cloud agents), make it one short-lived PR that fast-forwards onto `main`, and never build on top of it.
- **Never discard work.** No `git reset`, `checkout --`, `restore`, `clean`, `stash` or `revert`. Commit or push only when asked.
- **Never publish.** No `npm publish` / `pnpm publish`, no version bumps, no tags. Releases go through the monorepo cascade and CI.
- **Never edit generated output:** `dist/`. Fix the source or the generator.
- **Tests first.** A bug fix starts with a failing unit test at the owning component. It uses the real implementation, not a mock of the thing under test. Every positive case gets a paired control, and edge cases are listed before coding. The test stays as prevention.
- **Type safety.** No `as any`, no `unknown` casts, no `as unknown as X`, in tests too. A missing field means the upstream type is wrong; report it rather than shadow-typing it here.
- **No heuristics.** No text/label/name matching or guessed fallbacks. Use one deterministic, declared contract per concept.
- **Never truncate** logs, prompts, traces or persisted fields (`.slice`, `substring`, length caps).
- **No silent compromises.** Never drop a feature or take a shortcut without saying so plainly in your report.
- **Minimal comments.** Default to none; one short line only when the *why* is non-obvious.
- **Diagnose from evidence.** Read logs, or add them with the package logger, before claiming a cause.
- **Gaps live in `Almadar_Gaps.md` here.** Read it before starting. When you fix a gap, delete its entry in the same commit. A new gap you find in this repo gets an entry, using the file's `Next code` (bump it). A gap that needs another repo goes in your report or PR body instead.
- **Never npm/pnpm update** here. Lockfile-respecting installs only (`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`).

## Runtime rules
- This is the JS execution path. Every language feature must also exist in the Rust compiler path (`orbital-rust`). A behavior change here needs a matching Rust change and identical twin tests; report the Rust half if you can't make it.
